senses.gloss:
शिल् शिल् (also written सिल्), cl. 6. P.
शिलति, &c., to glean.

शील् शील् (perhaps to be regarded as a
Nom. fr. शील below), cl. 1. P. शीलति,
शिशील, शीलिष्यति, शीलितुम्, to meditate, contem-
plate, intend; to serve, worship, honour; to act, do,
practise, make; cl. 10. P. or Caus. शीलयति, -यितुम्,
Aor. अशिशीलत्, to honour, worship; to do, make,
practise repeatedly, exercise, engage in; to act or
practise excessively, exceed; to put on, wear, pos-
sess; to visit, frequent.
सिल् सिल्. See rt. शिल्.

शिल, अस्, अम्, m. n. gleaning, gathering stalks or
ears of corn, (according to Kullūka on Manu X.
112. शिल = अनेक-धान्योन्नयन, i. e. gleaning
more than one ear of corn at a time, opposed to
उञ्छ = एकैक-धान्यादि-गुडकोच्चयन.)
—शि-
लोञ्छ (˚ल-उञ्˚), अस्, m. gleaning ears of corn;
following irregular occupation.
—शिलोञ्छ-वृत्ति,
इस्, f. subsistence by gleaning; unusual or irregular
occupation.

शिला शिला, f. (probably connected with
rt. 1. शि or rt. शो), a stone, rock; a grindstone or
any flat stone on which substances are ground; the
lower timber of a door; a beam or stone placed
across the top of a pillar, the top or capital of a
column; a vein, tendon, (for शिरा, q. v.); red
arsenic; camphor; [cf. Lat. silex; Hib. clach,
cloch.]
—शिल-गर्भ-ज, अस्, m. (शिल for शिला), a
particular plant (= पाषाण-भेदन).
—शिला-
कर्णी, f. the olibanum tree, Boswellia Thurifera.
—शिला-कुट्टक, अस्, m. a stone-cutter's chisel or
hatchet.
—शिला-कुसुम, अम्, n. benzoin or storax,
(see शिला-ज.)
—शिला-घन, अस्, आ, अम्, firm or
hard as a stone or rock.
—शिला-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘rock-
born,’ produced in a mountain or rock, fossil, mineral;
(अम्), n. a kind of resin or bitumen; benzoin, storax
or styrax; petroleum; any fossil production; iron.
—शिला-जतु, उ, n. ‘stone-lac,’ bitumen; red chalk.
—शिला-जित्, त्, f. ‘rock-conquering,’ bitumen.
—शि-
लाञ्जनी (˚ला-अञ्˚), f. a particular plant or shrub (=
कालाञ्जनी).
—शिलाटक (˚ला-अट्˚), अस्, m. a room
on the top of a house (= अट्ट); a hole; a fence,
enclosure.
—शिला-तल, अम्, n. the surface of a rock
or stone.
—शिलात्मज (˚ला-आत्˚), अम्, n. ‘rock-
born,’ iron.
—शिलात्मिका (˚ला-आत्˚), f. a crucible.
—शिला-त्वच्, क्, f. = शिला-वल्का.
—शिला-दद्रु, उस्,
m. ‘rock-eruption,’ bitumen.
—शिला-धातु, उस्, m.
‘rock-mineral,’ chalk; red chalk; a white fossil
substance; an aluminous earth of a white or yellowish
colour (considered to be a sort of chalk).
—शिला-
पट्ट, अस्, m. a flat stone for grinding condiments
&c.; a slab used as a seat, a rocky seat.
—शिला-
पट्टक, अस्, m. a rocky seat.
—शिला-पुत्र or शिला-
पुत्रक, अस्, m. (पुत्र being used as a diminutive),
a roller for grinding condiments &c., a small flat
stone for pounding or grinding.
—शिला-पुष्प, अम्,
n. ‘rock-flower,’ storax or benzoin.
—शिला-पेष,
अस्, m. grinding with a stone.
—शिला-प्रतिकृति, इस्,
f. an image or statue of stone.
—शिला-फलक, अम्,
n. a layer or table of rock, a stone slab.
—शिला-
भव, अम्, n. ‘rock-produced,’ storax or benzoin.
—शिला-भेद, अस्, m. the plant Plectranthus Scu-
tellarioides (= पाषाण-भेद); a stone-cutter's
chisel.
—शिला-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of stone,
rocky, stony.
—शिलारम्भा (˚ला-आर्˚), f. the wild
plantain (= काष्ठ-कदली).
—शिला-रस, अस्, m.
‘rock-exudation,’ olibanum, benzoin, incense.
—शिला-
वल्कल, अस्, अम्, m. n. or शिला-वल्का, f. ‘rock-
bark,’ a kind of moss or lichen (especially a kind
used as a medicinal substance and said to be of cool-
ing and lithonthriptic properties; it is commonly
called Śilābāk).
—शिला-वितान, अस्, अम्, m. n. a
covering or expanse of stones, i. e. a shower of
stones.
—शिला-वृष्टि, इस्, f. ‘stone-rain,’ hail.
[]
—शिला-वेश्मन्, अ, n. ‘rock-abode,’ a cavern, grotto,
rocky recess.
—शिला-व्याधि, इस्, m. ‘rock-disease,’
bitumen.
—शिला-शित, अस्, आ, अम्, sharpened on a
grindstone.
—शिलासन (˚ला-अस्˚ or -आस्˚), अम्, n. a
stone bench or seat; benzoin or storax.
—शिला-सार,
अम्, n. ‘rock-essence,’ iron.
—शिलाह्व (˚ला-आह्˚),
अम्, n. ‘stone-named,’ bitumen, red chalk.
—शिली-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, converted into a rock, made hard.
—शिलोच्चय (˚ला-उच्˚), अस्, m. ‘rock-accumulation,’
a mountain; a high mountain.
—शिलोत्थ (˚ला-उत्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, growing upon rocks, produced from rocks
or stone; (अम्), n. benzoin, storax.
—शिलोद्भव
(˚ला-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, produced from stone or on rock;
(अम्), n. a superior sort of sandal-wood (either the
white or yellowish sort); benzoin.
—शिलोरस्क
(˚ला-उर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, rock-chested, having a chest as
hard as a rock (said of the Himālaya mountain).
—शिलौकस् (˚ला-ओक्˚), आस्, m. ‘dwelling in rocks,’
an epithet of Garuḍa.

शील, अम्, n. (according to Uṇādi-s. IV. 38. fr. rt.
1. शी; according to others fr. rt. 2. शिष्), disposition,
inclination, character, nature, natural disposition,
quality, tendency, custom, habit, usage, (in all these
senses said to be also अस्, m.); practice, behaviour,
conduct, (said to be also अस्, m.); good disposition
or character, good nature, amiability, good conduct,
moral practice, piety; virtue, morality, steadiness;
form, shape, beauty; (in all the preceding senses
often used at the end of adj. comps., e. g. दान-
शील, अस्, आ, अम्, disposed to give, cf. अभिवादन-
श्˚, गुण-श्˚, मांस-श्˚, पुण्य-श्˚, मृगया-श्˚,
कु-श्˚, सु-श्˚, वि-श्˚); (अस्), m. a large snake, (in this
sense fr. rt. 1. शी); (आ), f., N. of the wife of the
Muni Kauṇḍinya; [cf. Slav. sila, ‘strength, power.’]
—शील-ज्ञान-निधि, इस्, m. a treasury of virtue and
knowledge.
—शील-तट, अस्, आ, अम्, having virtue
for a bank or shore (said figuratively of a river).
—शील-तस्, ind. according to character, by natural
disposition; in regard to the character.
—शील-ता, f.
or शील-त्व, अम्, n. disposition, inclination; quality;
conversancy, practice.
—शील-धारिन्, ई, m. ‘virtue-
holder,’ epithet of Śiva.
—शील-निधि, इस्, m. a
treasure of virtue.
—शील-पारमिता, f. one of the
six perfections (with Buddhists).
—शील-भट्टारिका,
f., N. of a female poet.
—शील-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
possessed of good qualities, of a good or amiable
disposition, well-conducted.
—शील-वृत्त, अस्, आ,
अम्, well-conducted, moral, steady, uniformly, well-
behaved.
—शील-वृत्ति, इस्, f. practice of virtue,
good behaviour, virtue.
—शील-सम्पन्न, अस्, आ,
अम्, endowed with good nature or conduct, well-
disposed, of proper conduct or disposition, well-con-
ducted.
—शीलादित्य (˚ल-आद्˚), अस्, m., N. of a son
of Vikramāditya (= प्रताप-शील).

शिलि, इस्, f. the lower timber of a door; (इस्), m.
the birch tree (= भूर्ज-पत्त्र).

शिली, f. the lower timber of a door; the stone or
beam at the top of a pillar; a small earth-worm; a
spike, dart; an arrow.
—शिली-मुख, अस्, m. an
arrow; a bee; a fool, blockhead; war.

शिलेय, अस्, आ, अम्, coming from rock; like a
stone or rock, as hard as a rock, rocky, stony; (अम्),
n. benzoin; bitumen.
शिलाद शिलाद, अस्, m. a proper N.

शिलालिन् शिलालिन्, ई, or शिलालि, इस्, m., N. of
the supposed author of certain Naṭa-sūtras or rules
for actors.

शिलिन्द शिलिन्द, अस्, m. a kind of fish;
[cf. शिलीन्ध्र.]

शिलीन्ध्र शिलीन्ध्र, अम्, n. a mushroom,
fungus; the flower of the plantain tree; hail, = त्रि-
पुट; (अस्), m. a sort of tree; a kind of fish, =
चित्र-फलक; (ई), f. earth, clay; a small earth-
worm; a sort of bird.

शिलीन्ध्रक, अम्, n. a mushroom (especially one
growing out of cow-dung); a fungus.

शिलीपद शिलीपद, अस्, m. (= श्लीपद, q. v.),
enlarged or swelled leg, elephantiasis.
शिलोञ्छ शिलोञ्छ. See under शिल, p. 1006.
शिल्गु शिल्गु, उस्, m. = सुख (Naigh. III. 6).

शिल्प शिल्प, अम्, n. (according to Uṇādi-s.
III. 28. fr. rt. शील्), an art, any manual or mechanical
or fine art, (sixty-four such arts, sometimes called
वाह्य-कला, ‘external or practical arts,’ are enume-
rated, e. g. carpentering, architecture, jewellery, far-
riery, acting, dancing, music, medicine, poetry, &c.;
and sixty-four अभ्यन्तर-कला, ‘secret arts,’ e. g.
kissing, embracing, and various other arts of coquetry);
skill in any art, ingenuity, contrivance, skill (in
general); any act, work (enumerated among the
कर्म-नामानि in Naigh. II. 1); ceremonial act,
rite, ceremony, (in this sense apparently also अस्,
m.); form, shape (enumerated among the रूप-
नामानि in Naigh. III. 7, cf. सु-शिल्प); a particular
kind of Śastra or hymn (of a highly artificial cha-
racter); creation, procreation; a sort of spoon or
ladle used at sacrifices for throwing the clarified butter
into the fire; (अस्), m., N. of a teacher; (ई), f. a
female artisan or mechanic (regarded by Śāktas as
one of the eight Akulas).
—शिल्प-कर = शिल्प-
कार.
—शिल्प-कर्मन्, अ, n. or शिल्प-क्रिया, f.
manual labour, handicraft.
—शिल्प-कार, अस्, or
शिल्प-कारिन्, ई, m. an artisan, workman, mechanic.
—शिल्प-कारक, अस्, इका, अम्, practising any me-
chanical art, versed in an art; (अस्), m. an artisan.
—शिल्प-विद्या, f. the science of mechanics, me-
chanical knowledge, skill in art, mechanical or
manual skill.
—शिल्प-शाल, अम्, आ, n. f. a work-
[]
shop, workroom, manufactory.
—शिल्प-शास्त्र, अम्,
n. a book on any mechanical or fine art (as archi-
tecture &c.), a scientific treatise; the whole collection
of treatises on mechanical arts, mechanics.

शिल्पक, अम्, n. a sort of drama, one exhibiting
magical and mystical rites.

शिल्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, belonging or relating to any
mechanical art, mechanical; (ई), m. an artificer,
artist, artisan; (इनी), f. a kind of herb or grass
(called Lahānasipī in Hindī; it is used medicinally,
and described as sweet, cooling, and bearing seeds of
tonic and restorative properties; it is otherwise de-
scribed as a drug, = कोल-दल).
—शिल्पि-शाल, अम्,
आ, n. f. a workshop, a manufactory.
—शिल्पि-शास्त्र
= शिल्प-शास्त्र, q. v.
शिल्हन शिल्हन. See शिह्लन.

शीलन, अम्, n. repeated practice, habitual per-
formance, constant study (of the Śāstras &c.), ex-
cessive performance or exercise; wearing, putting on,
possessing; serving, honouring.

शीलयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, worshipping, honouring;
practising.

शीलित, अस्, आ, अम्, practised, exercised, skilled in,
conversant with; endowed with, possessed of; visited,
frequented; (अम्), n. practice, conduct.
सिलक सिलक, अस्, m. a proper N.

सिलिक सिलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according to
Sāy.) compact, symmetrical (= संसृत, सङ्गत).
—सिलिक-मध्यम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having com-
pact or symmetrical waists (= संसृत-मध्यम
or शीर्ष-मध्यम, Nirukta IV. 13).

सिल्लकी सिल्लकी, f. (= सल्लकी, शल्लकी), the
gum olibanum tree, Boswellia Thurifera.

सीलन्ध सीलन्ध, अस्, m. a kind of fish
(commonly called Silindā).

सीलमा सीलमा, f., Ved. (probably) a plant.
—सीलमा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having plants,
abounding in plants (said of the river Sindhu).
